headline: 54th Massachusetts, Black Regiment, Leads Heroic Charge on Fort Wagner
dispatch: Union troops under Colonel Robert Gould Shaw launched a desperate frontal assault on Confederate Fort Wagner on Morris Island last evening, the 54th Massachusetts Infantry leading the charge across a narrow beachhead under murderous fire. Shaw was killed at the parapet and the regiment suffered severe casualties, but the regiment's valor under fire has electrified the North. The battle stands as a defining test of African-American soldiers in the Union cause.
